license.name: Restroom Stalls and All (RSA)
license.registry: Tennessee Board for Licensing Contractors, Verify public search (verify.tn.gov, redirects to search.cloud.commerce.tn.gov)
license.note: The Tennessee license search is a JavaScript app behind reCAPTCHA, so no automated lookup was possible. Search by hand there. Tennessee requires a state contractor license only for prime contracts of $25,000 or more. Carpentry-type subcontractors working for a contractor are exempt (TN board application package). Chattanooga sets no separate city general contractor license (repo research). The company site lists Tennessee among the states it serves and lists no license numbers (restroomstallsandall.com). Base is Gainesville, GA, phone 1-844-817-8255.
